description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic and mortality information for patients in the dataset. It includes unique patient identifiers (SUBJECT_ID), gender, date of birth (DOB), and multiple date of death fields (DOD, DOD_HOSP, DOD_SSN) from different sources. An expire flag (EXPIRE_FLAG) indicates if the patient's record has expired.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the dataset.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, either 'M' (male) or 'F' (female).

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: The patient's date of birth.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: The patient's date of death from the main data source.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: The patient's date of death, as recorded in the hospital records.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: The patient's date of death, as recorded by the Social Security Administration.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient's record has expired (1) or not (0).

description: The `SERVICES` table contains information about patient transfers between different hospital services (departments) during their hospital admissions. Each row represents a single transfer event, identified by a unique `ROW_ID`. The table includes the patient identifier (`SUBJECT_ID`), hospital admission identifier (`HADM_ID`), the timestamp of the transfer (`TRANSFERTIME`), the previous service the patient was in (`PREV_SERVICE`), and the current service the patient was transferred to (`CURR_SERVICE`). This table can be used to track patient movement and service utilization within the hospital.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key which uniquely identifies a patient within the patient table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Foreign key which uniquely identifies a patient's hospital admission within the admissions table.

columns.name: TRANSFERTIME
columns.description: Timestamp indicating when the patient was transferred to the current service.

columns.name: PREV_SERVICE
columns.description: The patient's previous service (department) before the current transfer. Examples include CMED, SURG, etc.

columns.name: CURR_SERVICE
columns.description: The patient's current service (department). Examples include CMED, SURG, etc.

description: The TRANSFERS table contains information about patient transfers between different care units and wards within the hospital. It captures details such as the patient's previous and current locations (care unit and ward), the admission and discharge times associated with the transfer, the length of stay (LOS), and the source database. Each row represents a single transfer event.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source for the data, either 'carevue', 'metavision' or 'both'.

columns.name: EVENTTYPE
columns.description: Type of event, such as 'admit', 'transfer' or 'discharge'.

columns.name: PREV_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's previous care unit, e.g., 'TSICU', 'SICU', 'CCU'.

columns.name: CURR_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's current care unit, e.g., 'NICU', 'MICU', 'CCU'.

columns.name: PREV_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's previous ward.

columns.name: CURR_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's current ward.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: The length of stay (LOS) in days.

description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information on hospital admissions for patients. Each row represents a unique hospital admission (`HADM_ID`) for a patient (`SUBJECT_ID`). The table includes timestamps for admission and discharge, patient demographics (insurance, language, religion, marital status, ethnicity), details about the admission (type, location before and after the stay, diagnosis), and flags indicating in-hospital mortality and availability of chart event data. It serves as a core table for linking patient information across the MIMIC-III database.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Patient identifier; links to the PATIENTS table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Hospital admission identifier; links to the ADMISSIONS table. Uniquely identifies a patient's hospital stay.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient died, if applicable. If the patient did not die in the hospital, this field is null.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of admission, e.g., EMERGENCY, ELECTIVE, URGENT.

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the patient prior to admission to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location to which the patient was discharged after the hospital stay.

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: Type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Primary language of the patient. Note: certain values begin with special characters.

columns.name: RELIGION
columns.description: Religion of the patient.

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.description: Marital status of the patient.

columns.name: ETHNICITY
columns.description: Ethnic group of the patient.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was registered in the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient left the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The diagnosis given upon admission for the patient's hospital stay.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the patient expired (died) during the hospital stay (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the patient's hospital stay has data in the CHARTEVENTS table (1) or not (0).

description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on individual Intensive Care Unit (ICU) stays for patients. It links patients to their hospital admissions and specific ICU stay identifiers. The table includes data on the source database, care units, ward IDs, admission and discharge timestamps, and length of stay in the ICU. It can be used to analyze ICU utilization, patient flow, and length of stay patterns.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the patient's ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: Source database for the data, either 'metavision', 'carevue', or 'both'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's first care unit during their ICU stay (e.g., MICU, CSRU).

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's last care unit during their ICU stay (e.g., MICU, CSRU).

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at the start of their ICU stay.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at the end of their ICU stay.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: Length of stay in the ICU, in days.
